transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you so much for fitting me in. Um, I hope I'm doing this right, I've never really been to someone like you before. Is it okay if I just start from the beginning? 

Well, I'm really just here because... I've been under a bit of stress lately, and I've been trying for months now to get people to understand what's going on. It’s a family thing, mostly. My husband’s family is... well, they've been quietly messing with our money and our good name. I know that probably sounds terrible to say out loud, and I really don't want to seem like a difficult person or someone who complains. 

But I just see it happening. Like, I work as a billing clerk, and these little billing errors will just randomly show up at work, or... or someone at church will suddenly act really funny toward me. People try to pull up records or tell me it's just a mistake, but I know it ties back to his family. I'm sorry, I hope that doesn't make me sound unreasonable or anything. Does that make sense to you?
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people who were there couldn't hear?

Oh, um... no. No, nothing like that. I mean, I know sometimes people can experience things like that when they're under a lot of stress, but I definitely haven't heard any voices or sounds that aren't really there. Just normal everyday noises, you know? 

I hope that's a good sign? I really don't want you to think I'm... well, you know, making things up or losing my mind or anything. I'm just seeing real things that are happening with my family and my job. But no voices. I'm just trying to be as honest as I can so we can figure this out. Did I answer that okay for you?
Aside from the stress this has caused, have you been experiencing persistent feelings of sadness, depression, or feeling down most days?

Oh, no. No, definitely not depressed. I mean, it's... it's frustrating, of course, dealing with everything with his family, but I try really hard to keep a positive attitude. I don't want to be one of those people who just sits around feeling sorry for themselves, you know? 

I still get up, go to my job, and do my very best to be a good employee and a good person. I definitely don't feel sad or down most days. I hope that's okay? I just try to keep my chin up and push through it as best I can. Is that what you were asking?
Looking back over your life, even before these issues with your husband's family started, have you generally felt that other people couldn't be trusted?

Oh, um, no, not at all. I've always tried to see the best in people, really. I think most people are generally good and want to do the right thing. 

Before all this started with his family, I never really had any problems trusting anyone. I've always gotten along well with my coworkers, and I have some lovely friends from church. I've always believed that if you treat people with kindness and respect, they'll do the same for you. 

It's really just this specific situation with my husband's family that's been so... so difficult. I hope I don't sound like a suspicious or paranoid person, because that's really not who I am. I just want everything to be fair and honest. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining myself well enough.
